divergence: Canonical and relocation-strict objdiff both measure 93.80488% (baseline 92.30488%). Generated .text is 320 bytes versus retail 328. Retail materializes info at r31+0x1C in r7 and work at r31+0x98 in r7; generated code folds both into r31-relative accesses and omits those two addi instructions. Work-setup scheduling also differs (li r6 moves before the pointer store). The values fill loop now has the retail r4=r31+0xC0 base and zero-based store offsets, and the redundant root HA/LO reload is removed. Both objects have seven relocations with the same ordered types, symbol names, and zero addends, but the early call sites shift 0x44/0x4C to 0x40/0x48, the clear call shifts 0x80 to 0x78, and the final data HA/LO relocations shift 0x11E/0x126 to 0x116/0x11E. Bytes are not identical; retain NonMatching.

experiments.name: baseline
experiments.hypothesis: Fresh measurement of accepted base; not counted as a new experiment.

experiments.name: inline_helpers
experiments.hypothesis: Put info update, work reset, and values fill into TU-local inline C helpers to test whether the inliner preserves interior pointer bases after local optimization.

experiments.name: subobject_arrays
experiments.hypothesis: Represent info/work as one-element arrays to test array-decay address generation instead of scalar member address folding.

experiments.name: opaque_global
experiments.hypothesis: Declare external storage as an incomplete byte array and retain a typed local layout view; test whether symbol-level type knowledge causes the redundant global-address reload.

experiments.name: opaque_root
experiments.hypothesis: Use a byte pointer for the root and explicitly cast the loop array base; test whether array indexing can retain its own base without a pointer live across the clear call.

experiments.name: opaque_helpers
experiments.hypothesis: Combine opaque root with info/work inline helpers to test whether the new alias model enables the proposed inlining boundary.

experiments.name: opaque_global_cast_loop
experiments.hypothesis: Combine the successful opaque global declaration with a typed root and explicit byte-offset array base in the fill loop, separating symbol type knowledge from loop-base selection.

experiments.name: union_pointer_views
experiments.hypothesis: Use a local union of byte/info/work pointers to test whether pointer representation conversion prevents interior-base folding.

experiments.name: aggregate_work_reset
experiments.hypothesis: Test aggregate work assignment as a semantic reset that may preserve a distinct destination base; canonical C rejects the nonconstant aggregate initializer.

experiments.name: aggregate_work_copy
experiments.hypothesis: Valid C follow-up: initialize an all-zero Work aggregate, assign its values pointer, then copy it to the work subobject.

experiments.name: final
experiments.hypothesis: Retain opaque_global_cast_loop with an explanatory comment; fresh canonical and strict measurements.
